import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def run(inputs: dict) -> dict:
    df = inputs["payments"].copy()

    n = len(df)
    reason = pd.Series([None] * n, index=df.index, dtype=object)
    unresolved = pd.Series(True, index=df.index)

    # R1: amount IS NULL
    cond = unresolved & df["amount"].isna()
    reason[cond] = "AMT_NULL"
    unresolved &= ~cond

    # R2: amount <= 0
    cond = unresolved & (df["amount"] <= 0)
    reason[cond] = "AMT_NONPOS"
    unresolved &= ~cond

    # R3: currency NOT IN ('USD','EUR','GBP')
    valid_ccy = {"USD", "EUR", "GBP"}
    cond = unresolved & (~df["currency"].isin(valid_ccy))
    reason[cond] = "CCY_INVALID"
    unresolved &= ~cond

    # R4: country IS NULL
    cond = unresolved & df["country"].isna()
    reason[cond] = "CTRY_NULL"
    unresolved &= ~cond

    rejected_mask = reason.notna()
    passed_mask = ~rejected_mask

    clean_df = df.loc[passed_mask].copy()
    clean_df["amount"] = clean_df["amount"].round(2)
    clean_df = clean_df[["payment_id", "amount", "currency", "country"]]

    rejects_df = df.loc[rejected_mask].copy()
    rejects_df["reason_code"] = reason[rejected_mask]
    rejects_df = rejects_df[["payment_id", "amount", "currency", "country", "reason_code"]]

    return {
        "payments_clean": clean_df.reset_index(drop=True),
        "payments_rejects": rejects_df.reset_index(drop=True),
    }
